speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing right groin pain and having an abnormal leg position after a rear-end collision; can you tell me exactly how your leg was positioned immediately after the accident?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) tear with hip contusion.

The mechanism of injury (rear-end collision) and immediate onset of bilateral knee pain, combined with right groin pain, strongly suggest ligamentous injury. I need to confirm if you experienced a "popping" sound in your knee right after the accident.

REQUEST TEST: MRI_Knee_Right, MRI_Knee_Left.
REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray_Hip_Right, X-Ray_Knee_Right.
